column5: {candidate} run-cache key binds the -c object source argv spelling (srcraw): an absolute source in two dirs sharing a cache no longer reuses the first dir's object. Precise pinning (0.0.105): comment/string-literal __FILE__ does not pin; a real __FILE__, a CAT(__FI,LE__) fragment (same file, or ## in source with fragment in header, or ## and fragment both in the header), -DW=__FILE__, cross-file CAT, or header __FILE__ does; LF line splice forms __FILE__ (pinned) while a spliced line comment swallows it (not pinned). Pin assertions run on the -run route so srcraw cannot mask them. A header gaining __FILE__ no longer leaves the unit permanently cold (both pin keys tried). Six object/invariant checks, three negative controls. 25 assertions.
